advanced.userAgentProfileHint: Use this only when the upstream restricts or requires a specific client. Channel refreshes, checks, and tool requests will use the selected client's User-Agent; leave it off for normal channels.
advanced.operationHint: Set an override only when this operation does not follow the surface defaults. Model paths may use {model}.

advanced.internalSourceTypeHint: The connection wizard fixes the source type so authentication and validation rules cannot be changed accidentally.

advanced.subscriptionLimitHint: Protects this device and synchronizes with routing.
advanced.routeLimitHint: Synchronizes with routing; no subscription guard is applied locally.
advanced.concurrencyUnlimitedWarning: 0 removes the supplier-side local cap. The platform still uses only concurrency tokens proven by successful requests and allows at most one extra probe; it never grants unlimited traffic. Keep local or upstream protection in place.
advanced.concurrencyCriticalWarning: Very low concurrency may substantially reduce matching opportunities. Keep it if this is the channel's true stable limit.
advanced.concurrencyCapacityGuidance: This is only the channel's declared ceiling. The platform proves concurrency tokens with real successes and retracts conflicting tokens only on an explicit full signal. A sustainable value reduces probes, while a low value limits matching opportunities.
advanced.quotaReservePercentHint: Uses valid official primary quotas: the short window first, or the long window if no short window exists. Extra quotas are informational. Below the reserve, new requests stop; in-flight requests finish. 0 keeps no reserve, but exhausted quota still stops new requests. Antigravity retains per-model quota handling.
advanced.rpmUnlimitedRecommended: 0 adds no per-minute limit (recommended by default); maximum concurrency still caps simultaneous work.
advanced.rpmBelowConcurrencyWarning: The per-minute limit is below maximum concurrency, so the channel may quickly become unavailable.
advanced.rpmLowWarning: A low per-minute limit may reduce trades. Set it only when the upstream enforces this quota.
advanced.rpmConfigured: Limit this only when the upstream enforces a per-minute quota; 0 adds no extra limit.

If the configuration does not take effect, try these steps in order:
